Evidence: "We introduce the smoothing module as a technique to address this problem. As illustrated in Figure 1-(c), this component transforms discrete chunking operations into continuous representations" [HNET §2.2.2 Dechunking, p.6]
The smoothing module stabilizes training by converting discrete chunk boundaries into smooth, differentiable signals, enabling effective gradient flow and reducing compression ratio fluctuations during upsampling . [HNET §3.3 Ablation Studies, p.17; HNET §2.2.2 Dechunking, p.6]

ANSWERABLE: yes
